##### Project general facts

Côte d'Azur Monaco is a hotel like no other, reflecting the French Riviera's passionate spirit and easy glamour. This magnetic destination offers an unmatched vibe and a feeling like never before. From majestic balconies and rainy streets to panoramic sea views, the hotel oozes a raw energy that pulls you in from the moment you step on the shore. Expect racing hearts and unforgettable memories at a location that will take your breath away.

Guests surrender to the spectacular with world-class amenities including the longest private beach in Dubai, the Grand Azur pool — the largest and most sustainable pool in the Middle East — a climate-controlled street, an exclusive marina, the Monaco Beach Club, and the Grand Monaco Room. The party continues at the Champagne Bar and the glittering Discotheque, where you can party till dawn before heading back to your suite for turquoise dreams. La Brasserie de Monaco offers authentic French cuisine, while Le Cabaret features cabaret performances with stunning costumes, acrobats, and magicians.

The Party Rooms at Côte d'Azur Monaco offer an experience like nowhere else on the planet, redefining living and recreational spaces beyond the conventional. Offering some of the best amenities and luxurious interiors designed with a contemporary style, each suite is crafted for those who seek high-octane living. The Monaco La Mer Suite features private pool and beach access, ensuring the party never stops.


##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within The Heart of Europe, a destination of six islands located at The World, Dubai, this exceptional location offers Maldives-like islands just off Dubai's shores. Imagine turquoise waters, pristine white beaches, and a secluded paradise easily accessible by boat, with a shuttle service running every fifteen minutes and water taxis from Dubai mainland.

The location is distinguished by its unparalleled exclusivity and strategic connectivity. The Heart of Europe comprises six islands offering a unique blend of European experiences in an unrivaled holiday home destination. The area features Maldivian-like white sandy beaches, tropical gardens, and a rich calendar of European festivals and events. Nearby, guests can explore neighboring islands with hotels, cafes, and restaurants, creating a complete ecosystem of luxury and entertainment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies French Riviera glamour, island seclusion, and the ultimate in luxury living, The Heart of Europe delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of man-made grandeur, natural beauty, and a prestigious Dubai address makes it one of the most desirable destinations in the world. This is a place where one can check in loud, party till dawn, and surrender to the spectacular — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected to the city that has it all.
